title: Technology, Privacy, and the Organisation of Opinion
prompt: Some people believe that the convenience offered by digital technologies justifies the collection and use of personal data by companies and governments. Others argue that privacy is a fundamental right that should not be traded for convenience. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. In your answer, you should explain which view you find more convincing and why, and you should organise your ideas clearly with relevant examples. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先仔细阅读题目，明确题目要求你讨论的两种观点以及你需给出的个人立场。写作时，请确保段落结构清晰：引言段引出争议并表明立场，主体段分别讨论双方观点并给出理由与例子，结论段总结并重申你的观点。注意使用恰当的连接词和指代手段来组织观点，避免只罗列要点。请用英语作答，字数不少于250词。
